name: Kyron Medical AI Scheduling Agent
description: Flow-based conversational voice agent for clinical appointment scheduling based on physician protocols.
_note: SUBMISSION BLUEPRINT, not a Vogent import file: Vogent's Flow Builder has no JSON import (nodes are built in the UI as question / freeform / function-call nodes with Order+Variable+Condition-Type edges). Rebuild each node below in the UI using its vogent_ui hint. Set backend_base_url to the public HTTPS backend (ngrok for testing, EC2 domain for submission) in every webhook/function URL.

vogent_ui.note: Set flow variable patient.is_new = true on the new branch, false on the returning branch. booking and match read it.

nodes.prompt: Thank you for calling Kyron Medical Scheduling. Are you a new or returning patient?

vogent_ui.note: Vogent API functions are POST-only. Caller phone comes from dial metadata.
Greeting only, always continues to triage. Reference patient_lookup.patient.name via @.

nodes.prompt: Welcome back, {{patient.name}}. What symptoms or injury are you looking to be seen for today?

vogent_ui.note: Capture full name, then MUST go through node_create_patient so booking has a patient_id. Caller phone comes from dial metadata.

nodes.prompt: Welcome! Could I get your first and last name?

vogent_ui.note: Creates the record (duplicate-safe: returns the existing record if the phone is known). response.patient.id feeds node_book_appointment.
Extract all four slots from one natural answer; do not interrogate field by field.

nodes.prompt: Could you describe what symptoms or injury you need to be seen for? And which location works best — Main Campus, North Clinic, or Westside?

vogent_ui.note: Core protocol router. agent_speech in the response already contains plain-language redirect explanations and the two slot offers — speak it verbatim.
Recovery path for unclear complaints. Loops back to match once body_part + issue_type are known.

nodes.prompt: Just to make sure I route you correctly — is this for a recent fracture, a sports injury, a joint replacement evaluation, or a general consultation? And which body part is it for?

vogent_ui.note: Speak response.agent_speech verbatim (two time options max). Map the accepted time back to available_slots[].id for booking.
Backend already fell back to the next overlapping doctor; this node only handles the caller's yes/no.

nodes.prompt: No problem. I can check the next available doctor who treats the same issue — would you like me to do that?

vogent_ui.note: Only fires after explicit caller yes. Failures (double-booking, no slots, missing inputs) return HTTP 200 with success:false plus speakable agent_speech/confirmation_speech — never an HTTP error, so the agent can voice the recovery instead of hallucinating.
Terminal confirmation. Speak response.confirmation_speech verbatim (doctor, time, location). Set call.outcome_status = SCHEDULED and appointment.id from the booking response, then end.
Warm handoff. Set call.outcome_status = REDIRECTED before transfer. Replace transfer_number with the real intake line before demoing.

Telemetry only — runs after hangup so the caller never waits on it. STATUS IS AN ENUM, not Vogent's internal status: set call.outcome_status = SCHEDULED on the confirmation path, REDIRECTED on the transfer path, ABANDONED if the caller hung up mid-flow, FAILED otherwise. Backend coerces anything else to FAILED.
